citations.quote: Not taking a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (spironolactone or eplerenone) before admission.

claim_verdicts.why: The first elevated potassium (5.7 on 03-02 05:45) precedes the first spironolactone dose (03-03 10:20) by about 28 hours, and there was no pre-admission MRA.
